title: Understanding Ordinary Least Squares
text: The ordinary least squares (OLS) method is used to estimate the parameters in a linear regression model. It works by minimizing the sum of the squared differences between the observed values and the values predicted by the model. This is known as minimizing the mean squared error (MSE).

title: What Does Minimizing MSE Mean?
text: When we say that OLS minimizes the mean squared error, what does that imply about the relationship between the observed and predicted values?

title: Role of MSE in Model Accuracy
text: Minimizing the mean squared error (MSE) is crucial because it directly affects the accuracy of the model. A lower MSE indicates that the model's predictions are closer to the actual data points.
